transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since all the changes at work, I feel like I’m reacting badly to everything and I can’t adjust to the new setup no matter how hard I try. I'm really hoping to figure out why I'm having so much trouble coping with it all.
When you say you are reacting badly, do you find yourself feeling more depressed and tearful, or do you find that you are feeling more anxious, nervous, and restless?

It’s definitely more on the anxious, nervous, and restless side. I feel constantly on edge and overwhelmed, and when things go wrong at work, I get this mix of panic and anger like my fuse is just incredibly short. I don't really feel depressed or tearful, just really wound up and unable to calm down.
When exactly did these changes at work occur, and how long have you been feeling this way since they started?

The restructuring and changes at my distribution center started about five months ago. Within a few weeks of those new systems and shifts kicking in, I started feeling really on edge and overwhelmed, and I've been struggling like this for about four months now.
Beyond your feelings of being on edge, have these symptoms caused significant distress or interfered with your ability to perform your daily responsibilities outside of work?

Yes, this has definitely spilled over into my life outside of work. I've pretty much stopped doing my usual hobbies, like playing in my rec league basketball and going on museum visits. It feels like my entire life now just revolves around stressing about work.
Has this stress caused you to experience any physical symptoms, such as significant changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or persistent muscle tension?

I haven't really noticed any significant physical symptoms like major changes in my sleep, appetite, or muscle tension. The stress has mostly been emotional and mental, leaving me feeling really overwhelmed, on edge, and struggling to cope with all the work changes.
Have you experienced any periods where your anxiety or irritability was so intense that it caused you to act impulsively or behave in ways that are completely out of character for you?

Yes, when there's a small shipping error or a sudden schedule change, I get this sudden mix of panic and anger where I just want to walk out. It's led to me calling out of shifts and avoiding certain tasks because I feel so overwhelmed. That is completely out of character for me, since I’ve always been a very steady, organized, and methodical person.
